findings.summary: Tier 1 manufactured body forces and exact QoI references mathematically incomplete or inconsistent
findings.remediation: Corrected Family 1 fx formula, derived full exact body force for Family 3 Gaussian, redesigned Family 4 as isotropic mixed shear, verified symbolic equilibrium across all 40 configs, and verified exact QoIs against numerical quadrature.

findings.summary: Tier 3 refusal manifest used repeated category templates rather than 80 distinct executable test cases
findings.remediation: Rebuilt Tier 3 with 80 unique executable test cases (8 per category across all 10 priority categories), verified via dedicated execution harness achieving 100% refusal accuracy.

findings.summary: Budget exhaustion negated estimated_target_met even when computed uncertainty met requested tolerance
findings.remediation: Decoupled budget exhaustion from target attainment: estimated_target_met is True whenever metric <= tolerance, with budget_exhausted recorded as an independent flag.

findings.summary: require_m3_stability was optional/lax allowing four-grid configurations to bypass M3 stability checks
findings.remediation: Added explicit verification_mode parameter; four-grid mode strictly requires M3 and enforces stability criterion |p_012 - p_123| <= 0.50, refusing with UNVERIFIED_NON_ASYMPTOTIC on failure.

findings.summary: Weak numerical input validation for non-finite values, negative residuals, and unverified refinement ratios
findings.remediation: Added strict input validation: finite QoI checks, non-negative finite residual validation, refinement ratio r=2 validation, and scale-independent degenerate area checks.

findings.summary: Two-order quadrature comparison (order 14 vs 18) was insufficient to prove convergence
findings.remediation: Executed systematic 4-order quadrature study (orders 14, 18, 22, 26) on Case B using Duffy tensor Gauss-Legendre quadrature, proving geometric convergence and error ratio < 0.36% <= 1.0%.

findings.summary: Reference uncertainty gate was an enum description without an executable evaluation path
findings.remediation: Implemented functional reference_uncertainty evaluation gate (Priority 10) in ProblemAnalyser.evaluate_contract() and reconciled Tier 2 eigenfunction specs.

findings.summary: H5b allowed low denominator passes and sampling model lacked explicit statistical qualification
findings.remediation: Updated thresholds: H5b requires N_claims >= 10, otherwise classified as INCONCLUSIVE; documented non-IID sampling nature of deterministic benchmark families.

findings.summary: CI evidence reported local Windows execution without hosted GitHub Actions verification evidence
findings.remediation: Separated local vs hosted CI documentation and linked GitHub Actions execution evidence in reports/phase_c_amendment_2/CI_EVIDENCE.md.
